rgb_tokens._: rgba(R,G,B,a) washes. The triple names the tier colour the wash was cut from; the token is what that colour means in the donor look. The alpha becomes the percentage in color-mix().

literals.why: The plate behind an iframe that has not mounted yet. A quiet sunken well, as the donor draws one.

trading._scripts: wall.js drives the three demo frames under 'The rest of the bench' (the tier page got it from the composed page).

kicker._: The tier said 'Tier 2 · the work'. The front page has no tiers, so the label is the section's name.

container.name: fp-carry
container._: The box a piece follows. Every (min|max)-width @media in the tier CSS becomes an @container query on it, because the shell's sidebar makes the box narrower than the window.

overrides.why: The shell's track already caps the width (80rem) and pads the sides.

redact.why: A path on the owner's machine, in the sentinel-trader card's 'Where it lives' line (the tier generator reads it from the desk topology). The front page writes no local path (front_check.py no_local_data; D-A27 open question on the Tool Desk). To show it again, delete this entry.

literals.why: The checked feed switch. A dark blue fill in the tier; the donor's 'pressed' fill is --accent-bg, with --ink text on it (14.67 light, 12.94 dark).
Text on the --ink fill that the hover state paints. --bg is the inverse of --ink in both themes.
Text on the --live fill. --primary-ink is the token measured on --primary, which has the same value as --live in both themes (7.79 and 13.52).

rewrites.why: A control edge must reach 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The tier drew buttons, tabs and switches with its decorative rule colour. --wire is --hairline.

The chosen tab. The tier inverted it (ink fill), which left its '9 parts' line in --muted on --ink at about 3:1. The donor marks the current item with --accent-bg and --accent-ink, and --ink-faint holds 5:1 on it.
Pair of the rule above. The chosen tab keeps a second channel as well: its fill.
Section titles. The tier set them in a heavy display face; the donor sets titles at 600 on the UI face.
Pair of the rule above; --fs-title uses -.01em.
The marker that travels along the wire is a 7px dot, not a pill. The raw 50% becomes the one round token.

trading._extra_css: Last two rules: a script-only control inside a hidden host (the finale) computes display:none, not only its host; and with scripting off the opening lines show at once instead of fading in over two seconds (a page that waits on nothing). The mesh: labels are 13px so they stay readable at desktop widths, and below an 830px container the diagram and its caption give way to a note, because at that size the labels would draw under 8px.

insert.html: The parts diagram needs a wider screen. The five paths above list the same parts, in order.
insert.why: At 375px the diagram draws its labels at 2.5px. Below an 830px container it is replaced by this note; the path tabs above already list every part. The note stays hidden until the container is that narrow (extra_css).

games._container: No container: the tier-3 CSS has no width query, and a container box would become the containing block of anything fixed inside it.

overrides.why: The shell's track already caps the width (80rem) and pads the sides.

allow_fixed..player: The game player. It is display:none until a game name is opened, covers the window while it is open, and closes on Esc: a transient overlay like the Tool Desk popover, not a fourth chrome cluster. It sits outside the container (.wrap) on purpose, because a container query box would become its containing block.

literals.why: The player's backdrop. Opaque: at 95% the shell's own text shows faintly through the title bar on the light ground.
The game frame's ground before the game paints over it.

rewrites.why: A control edge must reach 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). --wire is --hairline.
Inside the shell the box is narrower than the window. A 330px minimum overflows a 270px box at 320px; min() lets the column shrink.
